text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"You really think we'd run away when the 
prize is right in front of us? 
We've been sizing up the rivals from 
above. Every single one of 'em."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, it's time for the true 
favorites! It's our turn! 
Make way for the main act!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Let's go, Tap. 
Let us intoxicate both hope and malice in 
equal measure!"
